pathways.name: Chloride and Bicarbonate Transport
pathways.description: CFTR-mediated chloride and bicarbonate secretion, with SLC26A9 as a modifier anion channel.

pathways.name: Epithelial Sodium Channel
pathways.description: ENaC-driven sodium absorption dehydrates the airway surface when CFTR function is lost.

pathways.name: TGF-beta Signaling
pathways.description: TGF-beta signaling promotes airway remodeling and modifies cystic fibrosis lung disease severity.

pathways.name: Inflammatory Cytokine Signaling
pathways.description: TNF and CXCL8 drive neutrophil-predominant airway inflammation in cystic fibrosis.

pathways.name: Mucus Obstruction
pathways.description: Defective ion transport produces dehydrated mucus that obstructs airways and sustains infection.
